shorts_extract.hook: Paralyzed for 11 years by ALS, 68-year-old Pat Bennett silently mouths a sentence as words stream across a Stanford monitor at 62 words per minute.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Two 64-electrode arrays (128 channels) on ventral premotor cortex 6v feed a recurrent neural network decoding 39 English phonemes across a 125,000-word vocabulary.
shorts_extract.twist: Classical Broca's area 44 held almost zero phoneme signal, whereas speech motor cortex 6v kept a sharp lip-and-tongue map after a decade of paralysis.
